title: 70 days into building a simulated cozy town for a 24/7 lofi stream.
author: porchplant
selftext:
As you can see, this has been quite a journey! I consume a lot of lofi on YouTube and wanted something on my TV that wasn't a repeating scene. The stream follows the life of Maple (the fox) who is the town Radio host. Claude simulates her day, what she does, who she chats with, and what happens in the town in general. I love being surprised/delighted by the little things that happen. The residents' conversations are also generated based on what's happening in their world, so it's not just a collection of scripted animations/words.  
  
I have had SO much fun with Claude code and making charming additions like changing weather/seasons/decor. I gave everyone costumes on Halloween lol... Today I spent the day perfecting the menu and items in the town cafe. 

Happy to answer any questions! If you're interested in checking out the live stream, you can find it [here](https://www.youtube.com/@cozytownradio/streams).
